critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_estimate_market_pnl assumes at least 1 shift when reqs is empty and uses a $12/hr fallback — reasonable, but note the fallback deviates from role-based averages; if any business_type ships without staffing_requirements, its estimate will not match the real supply-chain math. Consider a warning log if reqs is empty.

server.py:894-901: wages default to '$12.00/hr * 8h = $96/day' when reqs is empty; the actual owned P&L uses role averages ~$180/day. Not a bug for current 10 seeded types (all have staffing_requirements), just tech debt.

BusinessMarket.jsx handles missing est.product gracefully via optional chaining — good. Consider showing 'staff_needed' recommended headcount in the card so buyers understand the assumption behind 'Est./day at recommended staffing'.
